title: docs(skills,lint): objectstack-automation teaches oauth2 and app-credential as a served recipe; the flow-credential-literal explanation says the built-in providers run the grant (#28299)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoGmHhhmdLvicENGKahs4yY4)_

Fixes #28299

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：automation skill 的集成食谱把「OAuth 厂商：还没有服务器跑授权，标记 blocked」改成一条可用食谱（recipe 6）：`oauth2`（`authorization_code` / `client_credentials`）和 `app-credential`（飞书 / 钉钉 / 企业微信）三种 `auth` 写法、token 由服务器按次获取、`authorization_code` 由管理员按组织连接一次（`POST …/connectors/:name/connection`、回调、状态、撤销）。eval 1 的评分标准同步；SKILL.md 的「loader 还不能吃的文档」一行去掉 OAuth；lint 的 `flow-credential-literal` 解释文案不再说「要等服务器跑授权」。
- 为什么改：#26702 S2 全部合并（#28399、#28419、#28437）后，内置 `rest` / `openapi` / `mcp` 都会按次向凭据句柄取 token，skill 里那句「no server runs the grant yet」已经是假话，会让 AI 作者把能用的集成标成 blocked（分诊定 p2 的产品缺陷）。
- 风险与回滚：只改教学文本、eval 评分标准和一句 lint 解释；不改 schema、键或运行时。`integration-recipes.md` 的 token 上限按实测从 2236 抬到 2523（同文件先删了两处复述，走 6513306068 的既定路径）；SKILL.md 上限按实测下调到 6454。回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`skills/objectstack-automation/references/integration-recipes.md`（recipe 6 与两处删减）、`skills/objectstack-automation/evals/integrations-declared.json`（eval 1）、`packages/lint/src/rule-explanations.ts`（一段文案）。
- 两分钟验证：`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`，预期两行 `objectstack-automation` 都 `headroom 0` 且整体绿；对照 `content/docs/automation/connectors.mdx` 的 Grant-bearing kinds 一节核对 recipe 6 的每一句。
- 需要你做的：Tier H（`skills/**`）——席位做完 Fable 契约复审并写席位核对后，由你批准 / 入队合并。

## What changes

**`skills/objectstack-automation/references/integration-recipes.md`** (the card's item 2)

- The "Not yet" OAuth bullet ("no server runs the grant yet: the instance is held degraded … Blocked on the outbound-OAuth card") becomes **recipe 6 · OAuth or vendor-app token — the server runs the grant**: served on `rest`, `openapi` and `mcp` (`http` transport only; a `stdio` server's credentials ride `transport.env`); the token is fetched per dispatch, kept in memory, refreshed before expiry and once on a `401`; the three `auth` shapes (`authorization_code` with `authorizationUrl` / `tokenUrl` / `scopes` / `clientId` / `credentialRef`, `client_credentials`, `app-credential` with the vendor's token placement); `client_credentials` and `app-credential` dispatch once the ref is set; an `authorization_code` instance is degraded "not connected" until an administrator holding `manage_connector_connections` (organization admins by default) connects it once per organization from a signed-in session (`POST /api/v1/automation/connectors/:name/connection` → `{ authorizationUrl }`, the vendor's redirect to `GET …/connectors/oauth/callback`, `GET` status, `DELETE` revoke); endpoints `https://`; on `mcp` the endpoints and `clientId` may be left to discovery. The `bearer`-ref warning stays, as the card asked. Every sentence is read from `content/docs/automation/connectors.mdx` § Grant-bearing kinds on `main` and the code it describes (`packages/services/service-automation/src/plugin.ts`, `oauth2-grant/app-credential.ts`, the three `connector-*-plugin.ts` registrations with `{ credentialHandle: true }`, `packages/runtime/src/route-ledger.ts`, `plugin-security` default permission sets).
- "Not yet" keeps WeChat Pay alone (no `signed` scheme).
- **Token ceiling, paid first by two same-file restatement cuts, then re-locked at the measurement** under the standing path (ruling record 6513306068; maintainer ruling 2026-10-27 「A:先削重复,余额按实测提高」):
  1. recipe 3's three-line agent-exposure example (`refresh_low_stock` with `ai: { exposed: true, … }`) — its home is `objectstack-ai` § Actions as AI Tools, which the surviving one-line pointer names;
  2. recipe 5's "Each `operationId` is a named action in the flow palette and to agents" — the Holds bullet already says actions come from the upstream's `operationId`s (the `provider: 'rest'` half of the sentence stays).
  Arithmetic (`ceil(bytes / 4)`): 8938 bytes on `main` (2235 tokens, 1 token under the 2236 row) → 10089 bytes (2523 tokens): −308 cut, +1459 added, +1151 net. Row 2236 → 2523, pinned at the measurement; the comment above the row records it.

**`skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md`** — the loader-gap sentence (≈L416) drops "OAuth" (the loader takes it now). "request signing" stays: the `signed` kind serves three schemes, and WeChat Pay's is still missing, so a document declaring that scheme is still a gap. Pure shrink; the row is re-locked 6457 → 6454 at the measurement.

**`skills/objectstack-automation/evals/integrations-declared.json`** — eval 1 (DocuSign): the rubric now expects the `oauth2` `authorization_code` declaration, the built-in `openapi` provider obtaining the token per dispatch, and the per-organization connect, and names one remaining gap (the vendor-signed Connect webhook, polled). `must_contain` gains `oauth2`, `authorization_code`, `/connection` and drops `blocked`; `must_not_contain` gains `blocked on outbound OAuth`.

**`packages/lint/src/rule-explanations.ts`** (the card's cross-domain exception, as #28226) — the `flow-credential-literal` explanation's "carry a grant whose token the server obtains per dispatch, and until it runs that grant such an instance is held degraded and calls no upstream" becomes "… obtains per dispatch through the built-in `rest`, `openapi` and `mcp` providers (an `authorization_code` instance once an administrator connects it); on a provider that does not ask the credential handle such an instance is held degraded and calls no upstream". The four facts its test pins (`lint-flow-credential-literals.test.ts`) still hold verbatim. `git grep -n -E "runs that grant|takes the grant|grant yet" packages/lint packages/services` finds no other string: the service's own reason text (`credentialHandleNotAppliedReason`, "does not yet ask the per-dispatch credential handle") is still true for a third-party provider.

**Changesets** — `.changeset/28299-automation-skill-oauth-recipe.md` (`@objectstack/skills` patch) and `.changeset/28299-lint-grant-steer-served.md` (`@objectstack/lint` patch), both carrying the two declaration lines.

**Readings (`skills/**` diff)** — lines / tokens (`ceil(utf8 bytes / 4)`, stamp line excluded):

| file | before | after |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `references/integration-recipes.md` | 158 lines / 2235 tokens (ceiling 2236) | 178 lines / 2523 tokens (ceiling 2523) |
| `SKILL.md` | 450 lines / 6457 tokens (ceiling 6457; the gate read 6454 on `main` + this diff) | 450 lines / 6454 tokens (ceiling 6454) |
| whole package, all `SKILL.md` (sum) | 56506 tokens (`main` 1f1a369b) | 56504 tokens |
| whole package, priced bundle total | 220019 tokens (`main` 1f1a369b, whole shipped tree) | 220384 tokens (+365: +287 recipes, −3 SKILL.md, +81 eval 1, measured not ratcheted) |

## Why

#26702 S2 landed in full: #28399 (`7e9f8143`, the built-in `rest` and `openapi` providers register with `credentialHandle: true`, `app-credential` served), #28419 (`380a1078`, the connectors page), #28437 (`70646157`, an OAuth-protected MCP server connects). The skill still taught "no server runs the grant yet: mark the integration blocked", which triage graded a p2 product defect (「写给 AI 的文档与 skills 说错一句，等于产品缺陷」). The card's item 1 (the interim "no built-in provider takes the grant yet" wording) is overtaken by item 2.

## Tests

Head `5af07314`, under the shared verify lock (`os-verify-lock.sh`, VERDICT lines read):

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/rule-explanations.test.ts src/lint-flow-credential-literals.test.ts` → Test Files 2 passed, Tests 24 passed (the four pinned facts of the explanation, including `held degraded and calls no upstream`, still hold).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint test && pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint typecheck` → Test Files 184 passed (184), Tests 7718 passed (7718); typecheck exit 0; `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `skills/objectstack-automation/evals/integrations-declared.json` parses (`json.loads`); no root eval runner exists for `skills/**` (see Acceptance notes).
- No ablation: no tested behaviour changes (text, a rubric and an explanation paragraph).

- The ten dist-dependent families (`check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:dts-closure`, `check:lean-entry-closure`, `check:published-files`, `check:sourcemap-no-sources-content`, `check:test-source-alias`, spec `check:skill-docs` / `check:skill-refs` / `check:duration-unit-keys`, lint `check:doc-formula-expressions`) ran after `pnpm build --filter='./packages/**'` (77 tasks, 9m25s under the lock) → all exit 0.

- `pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:role-word`, `check:keyed-text-bounds`, `check:closed-ceremony-text`, `check:issue-citations`, `check:changeset-gate-self-tests`, `check:empty-changeset`, `check:adr-0087-registration` → exit 0.

CI at report time: in_progress (the PR has just been opened).

## Acceptance notes

- `SKILL.md` keeps "request signing" in the loader-gap list: `ConnectorSigningSchemeSchema` serves `aliyun-acs3-hmac-sha256`, `tencentcloud-tc3-hmac-sha256` and `alipay-v3` only, and `integration-recipes.md` still lists WeChat Pay under "Not yet", so the words are still true for a document declaring any other scheme.
- No root eval runner exists for `skills/**` (the fixtures score the skill for maintainers; `check:skill-eval-tokens` is the `ui/` catalogue's gate). The eval file was validated as JSON and measured by the token ratchet (eval fixtures are measured, not ratcheted).
- Recipe 6 does not name a Console Connect page: none exists on `main` (the route ledger calls the connect "the Console's Connect / Reconnect flow (ADR-0143 S4)", a later #26702 slice this card does not wait on). The recipe teaches the three HTTP calls the ledger serves.
- Not changed, noted for the server lane: `credentialHandleNotAppliedReason` in `service-automation` says a provider "does not yet ask" the handle — true for a third-party provider, so left as is.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (No schema touched.)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; the lint package's own lint is CI's run.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` not touched.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English (the 维护者速读 block is the repo's own Chinese form).
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
